target.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail
target.body:
Related: #98313

Supersedes #98313 with clean maintainer-owned ancestry from a verified-green `main` SHA. The original diagnosis and canonical-reader fix are by @yetval; Yuval's commit is preserved as the first patch in this branch, and each maintainer refinement retains co-author credit.

AI-assisted: implementation and validation were completed with Codex.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators using `/allowlist` or approving a pairing code could silently lose every existing authorized sender when the account's `allowFrom` store was present but unreadable. A failed pairing approval could also consume the pending code, forcing the sender to pair again after permissions were repaired.

## Why This Change Was Made

Mutation pre-reads now use the canonical allowFrom reader with a fresh-read, fail-closed policy while retaining ordinary cached enforcement reads and existing malformed-JSON behavior. Read and normalization failures abort before the atomic rewrite, and pairing approval removes the pending request only after the idempotent allowFrom grant succeeds.

## User Impact

Unreadable or non-normalizable authorization stores are left byte-identical instead of being rebuilt from an empty fallback. Existing authorized senders remain intact, missing stores still support first-time pairing, account isolation and adapter normalization are unchanged, and failed pairing approvals remain retryable after the underlying store problem is repaired.

## Evidence

- Publication base: verified-green `main` SHA `aae1189d90f15a2a1b9cd96fbd629c8d60d1ae04`; CI run 28507984536 settled 108 jobs with zero failures.
- Exact replay sanity: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/pairing/pairing-store.test.ts src/pairing/allow-from-store-file.test.ts` -> 2 files, 18 tests passed.
- Formatting: `oxfmt --check` passed for all three changed files; `git diff --check` is clean.
- Linux permission proof: Testbox `tbx_01kwecmezcwqy28x44yqqkykz8` exercised the real `/allowlist` and `approveChannelPairingCode` mutation paths with a root-owned `0600` store; both raised `EACCES` and preserved the seeded authorization bytes and entries.
- Broader changed checks on the reviewed patch: Testbox `tbx_01kwecsr9kwptmdt4ehnn8q8nx` passed.
- Fresh ancestry-clean autoreview: bundled `codex-cli 0.143.0-alpha.26`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `xhigh`; zero findings, correctness 0.97.
- Bounded change: only `src/pairing/allow-from-store-file.ts`, `src/pairing/pairing-store.ts`, and `src/pairing/pairing-store.test.ts` differ from the leased base.

No `CHANGELOG.md` edit.
